description: "The Story of My Heart: An Autobiography" by Richard Jefferies is a spiritual autobiography published in 1883.
longDescription: In this unconventional work, Jefferies idealizes the English countryside as a kind of utopia, expressing themes similar to the transcendentalist movement.
